source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Outside an **[Attached unit](vsdata:core-rule/attached-units)**, this unit can't be seen by enemy models more than 12″ away, and an **[[INDIRECT FIRE]](vsdata:weapon-ability/indirect-fire)** weapon can target it only from within 12″. **[Lone Operative X″](vsdata:core-ability/lone-operative)** uses X″ instead of 12″.

In an Attached unit:

- It benefits only if every model has **[Lone Operative](vsdata:core-ability/lone-operative)**.
- If models have different ranges, the highest among those on the battlefield applies to the whole unit.
- Once **below Starting Strength**, it regains **[Lone Operative](vsdata:core-ability/lone-operative)** as soon as every remaining model has it.

Examples:

- A **CHARACTER** with **[Lone Operative](vsdata:core-ability/lone-operative)** leading a bodyguard unit with **[Lone Operative 15″](vsdata:core-ability/lone-operative)** uses 15″ for the whole unit.
- A **CHARACTER** with **[Lone Operative](vsdata:core-ability/lone-operative)** leading a bodyguard unit without it regains **[Lone Operative](vsdata:core-ability/lone-operative)** once every bodyguard model is **destroyed**.
